column1: # English words recognized inside romaji input.
# Tab-separated: the word as typed (lowercase, matched case-insensitively
# against the keystrokes), its kind, and optionally its usual spelling, which
#   p  proper noun or product name: kept in Latin script even when the
#      keystrokes also read as romaji (`amazon` is not あまぞん).
#   c  common word: kept in Latin script only when the keystrokes don't read
#      as plain romaji (`hello` would need the small-kana spelling へっぉ), or
#      when the text around the cursor is English. `make`, `name`, `time` read
#      as まけ・なめ・ちめ and stay Japanese otherwise.
# The katakana loanword table (loanwords.tsv) contributes its single-word
